candidate.user_submission: Di pikin dey 18 months old. E get diarrhoea wey don last for 3 days. E dey drink normal. E never dey restless or dey irritable. When I pinch e skin, e skin return normal. E eyes no dey sunk. No blood dey inside stool. Di pikin no dey convulse now, e never convulse before, e no dey lethargic, e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Di pikin no get cough or any wahala for breath. E no get ear problem. E no get fever.
